context:
Goal: the receipt-close check stops crying wolf, so a real alarm is not scrolled past.
Problem (rule): the check's `lane-missing` line fires on every open item with `holds`, but `holds` is also set when an item waits on a merge or a PR, not a lane. The check has no signal that tells a lane wait from a PR wait, so most of its alarms are false. Step close-writes-receipt-answer-gone lists lane-missing as a check in scope (2); dropping it changes that scope.
Based on (read): lane receipt-close-express's account via the coordinator, 15:04 CST Nov 13. Triage has read neither the check nor the PR. Past rulings: none found on lane-missing in the roadmap record (rulings or steps); your 13:32 CST ruling own-receipt-fix-express only made the lane express.
Departs from: main — the step's scope (2) lists lane-missing as a check; this makes it posting text only (set `lane` on the item when a lane waits) plus the lane named on `answer-unread` lines.
Meanwhile: the lane fixes its other review findings and waits on this one.
lastAnswer: B but fix it in the same go

options.gain: The check stops raising false alarms, so a real one gets read.
options.label: Drop lane-missing from the check; keep the lane as posting text and on answer-unread lines (Recommended)
options.lose: Nothing checks that an item which waits on a lane names that lane; only the posting text asks for it.

options.gain: A lane that waits with no lane set is still caught by a check.
options.label: Keep lane-missing, and first add a field that tells a lane wait from a PR wait
options.lose: More work: a new field on every item, a lane for it, and the check stays noisy until it ships.

owner: lane receipt-close-express (session_013NEJL3o4VZAch2NXdx3diD), via the coordinator (session_013NEJL1gw6EdrSyvHkTUEx6); posted by triage (session_013NEJKzCzoWhfP8FMCPtQU6)
reply: Option b, built in the same lane and PR (#3264), not later. Filed as ruling own-766-b-field-now and sent to the lane.
short: Drop the lane-missing alarm from the receipt-close check?
title: Drop the lane-missing alarm from the receipt-close check, or keep it with a new field?
why: The alarm fires on every item with `holds`, including PR waits, so it is mostly false; dropping it narrows an approved scope.
